verdict.rationale: Beamer's homepage names an API among its integration offerings, so the product claims a public API of its own. The pack holds no API reference, endpoints, auth model or coverage details, and probes for an OpenAPI spec and an api.md found nothing (HTTP 404). Missing for 10: documented API reference with endpoints and operations, authentication details, machine-readable spec (OpenAPI), evidence the API can drive core actions like posting changelog entries or managing segments, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Find 3,000+ available integrations, API and Webhooks
